summary: First-finish smoke test of NBS proximity chat app. Backend endpoints verified end-to-end via curl across two users (A=+15550001111, B=+15550002222) at Bengaluru coords. Frontend login flow, Home availability toggle, radius slider, manual coordinates, nearby list, and navigation to Requests/Friends/Profile/Support all working.
passed: POST /api/auth/verify-otp with 123456 -> JWT + user (new user auto-created with default name UserNNNN); invalid OTP returns 401 'Invalid OTP'
PUT /api/users/me -> updates name/email/destination/bio (echoed in response, persisted)
GET /api/users/nearby -> returns User2222 at 62.1 m from User1111 with my_radius=500; excludes self; empty when location absent
POST /api/requests/send -> creates pending; duplicate returns 'Already sent'; self -> 400 'Cannot send to yourself'
GET /api/requests/incoming -> lists pending with request_id and from user
POST /api/chat/send between friends -> message saved & returned; empty text -> 400 'Empty message'; non-friend -> 'Not connected with this user'
Frontend Login: phone -> Send OTP -> OTP -> Verify -> lands on Home with welcome toast
Frontend Home: availability-toggle flips to 'You're live'/'You're offline'; radius-slider visible; manual lat/lng entry saves; nearby-list renders User2222 with distance and Send Request button
Frontend Requests page: renders empty state correctly after acceptance
Frontend Friends page: shows AliceUpdated with destination 'Mall'
Frontend Profile & Support pages: render with profile-name-input and support-submit-button present

failed.issue: Chat icon button on the friend row does not expose a data-testid matching 'open-chat-{id}' (no such selector found). Visually a round chat icon is present and likely functional, but automated testing of 'tap to chat' requires the testid.
failed.evidence: page.query_selector_all('[data-testid^="open-chat-"]') returned 0 elements while a chat icon is visible in the Friends row.

failed.issue: 'Made with Emergent' badge (#emergent-badge) overlays the bottom-right tabs (Profile/Support) at mobile width 390px and intercepts pointer events, blocking taps on the rightmost nav buttons.
failed.evidence:
Playwright click on nav profile link timed out: '

Made with Emergent

from subtree intercepts pointer events'. Workaround: direct URL navigation works.

failed.issue: PUT /api/users/me response does not include the 'email' field that was just set, whereas GET /api/users/me does. Minor inconsistency; data is persisted correctly.
failed.evidence: PUT response: {... 'name':'AliceUpdated','destination':'Mall','bio':'hi' ...} (no email key). GET includes email.

action_items: Add data-testid='open-chat-{friend_id}' to the chat icon button on Friends page so chat navigation can be automated.
Reposition or add padding so the Emergent badge does not overlap the mobile bottom navbar at 390px width (badge currently blocks the Profile/Support tabs).
(Optional) Include 'email' (and 'radius') in PUT /api/users/me response for consistency with GET.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - mock OTP 123456 for any phone; used +15550001111 and +15550002222.
